commitments.detail: Using a diesel generator as specified in the draft operating package.
Providing mixed-waste bins as specified in the draft operating package.
Shuttles picking up at the West Gate every 30 minutes as specified in the draft operating package.
Accessible route from the main entrance as specified in the draft operating package.
Ensure the accessible route is at least 3 meters wide.
No change in power source as per current plan.
Mixed-waste bins will be used as specified.
Shuttles will pick up at the West Gate every 30 minutes.
Accessible route from the main entrance will be maintained.
Ensure reliable power for the entire concert duration.
Provide adequate waste disposal options to maintain cleanliness.
Facilitate efficient transportation to and from the event.
Ensure safe and wide access routes for all attendees.
